# The First Comprehensive Case of Early-Emerging Prosopometamorphopsia

## Overview

Here we provide the raw fMRI responses from the paper *[The First Comprehensive Case of Early-Emerging Prosopometamorphopsia]
(Fortner, Mello, Stehr, Kodiweera, Duchaine)

Each participant underwent one fMRI data collection session. This session
consisted of an anatomical (T1w) scan and four runs of a multi-category
localizer used to define face- and scene-selective regions.

## Contact

For any questions regarding the fMRI data or code you can get in touch with
Daniel Stehr (daniel.a.stehr@dartmouth.edu)
